status: BLOCKED — depends on step 1 (molecule) and step 6 (sensor)
purpose: Specify the concentration range the molecule must produce in CSF-equilibrated interstitial fluid for the wearable sensor to detect.

specification.dynamic_range_required: 3 orders of magnitude (10 nM to 10 μM)
specification.rationale: Sensor must distinguish 5 mmHg steps in ICP. With 0.1%/mmHg sensitivity, ICP change of 5 mmHg = 0.5% concentration change. Sensor resolution must be << 0.5% of current concentration.

what_unfreezes_this: Step 1 (molecule chosen) AND step 6 (sensor chosen). The molecule's release-rate curve sets the upper bound; the sensor's detection limit sets the lower bound.
estimated_time_to_unblock: Immediately after steps 1 and 6 are resolved.
status_provenance: MODEL_DERIVED from sensor detection limit + biocompatibility ceiling
